terms.gloss: set quivering, move quickly to and fro, brandish, shake
evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.325: hastās ante pugnam (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: sī in Parthiā nātus esset, arcum īnfāns statim tenderet; sī in Germāniā, prōtinus puer tenerum hastīle vibrāret
phrases.english: had he been born in Parthia he would be drawing a bow as a baby; if in Germany, he would be brandishing a light spear as soon as he was a boy

sources: Lewis & Short: vibro
